title: Bundle spawn request construction, queue ownership and deferred entity creation
status: Static instruction and ownership trace; no native callable ABI or gameplay spawning guarantee.

checks.label: collect root and shared child collections
format unique instance name with registry counter
derive instance identifier from generated name
build dependency group from gathered components
wrap dependency group in shared ownership
append root request to registry queue
construct child request with parent initializer
allocate runtime entity handles after queue submission
stage content components for generated entity
registered scheduler dispatcher to request consumer
request destructor releases owned content descriptor

arguments: Lua argument 1 is read as a string and resolved through the content-name registry.
Lua argument 2 is converted to an eight-byte value and inserted in a typed initializer; exact accepted entity representation is unresolved.
Optional argument 3 supplies a four-float position vector; missing value becomes zero.
Optional argument 4 supplies a four-float orientation; normalized when norm is positive, otherwise identity quaternion (0,0,0,1).
entry.wrapper_result: Returns zero Lua results after success; compares native output against an engine-generated failure ID and raises a script error on failure.
entry.native_output: Leading identifier of the first generated content descriptor; runtime entity allocation happens later in the queue consumer. Not a live entity handle or completion token.

observations: Type selected by virtual runtime type index at vtable+0x88.
Root is appended only after the SharedEntityCollectionComponent is found.
Resolvable child references append collection pointers; missing children are skipped in this loop.
Name references contain ID at +0, cached pointer at +8, registry epoch at +0x10 and lock byte at +0x14; stale epoch re-resolves through 0x3282ab0.
These content references are distinct from resource objects whose reference count is +0x64.
Increments registry counter supplied as SpawningPoolRegistry+0x40 for each collection.
Formats an instance name and derives an eight-byte identifier with 0x3287a20.
Allocates a descriptor containing generated ID, component count and pointers; registers it through 0x32825b0.
Clones component payloads via reflection virtual operations rather than borrowing the complete template array.
Destructor 0x1b08940 unregisters the generated ID if an owned allocation exists, destroys component storage and frees the descriptor.

request_fields.0x00: opaque constructor argument; zero on the reviewed script root/child path
request_fields.0x48: group key forwarded from the script owner/context identifier
request_fields.0x50: optional requested runtime entity; -1 requests allocation in consumer

pending_queue.transfer: Constructor and append paths clear moved-from owner slots. These records cannot be duplicated with memcpy as independent owners.
pending_queue.consumption: 0x188f780 passes the batch to 0x18964a0, destroys every request and sets count to zero. Empty queue does not imply initialized entities.

observations: Groups requests by +0x48 and gathers their instance descriptor pointers.
Separates supplied +0x50 handles from entries whose low 32 bits equal 0xffffffff.
Allocates missing full eight-byte runtime entity handles via EntityGeneratorApi 0x1d635c0, distinct from generated content IDs.
Appends handles into command-buffer pages and uses a temporary command-buffer entity index with a deferred flag.
Stages content components through 0x1b07bb0 and spawning metadata through 0x1892090.
Moves the shared dependency owner out of request+0x28/+0x30 into command storage and clears the source.
Registers cleanup callback 0x1893ec0 for the moved shared owner; it decrements strong and weak control-block counts and invokes destruction at final release.
Invokes each typed initializer callback at record+0x40 against the deferred entity index; callback execution is not arbitrary user-supplied script code.
deferred_creation.scheduler: Dispatcher 0x1893610 derives command buffer from engine worker index, stride 0x1b8 and world+0x585e8; callers must not substitute an arbitrary worker thread.

future_bridge.primitive: Owner-scoped asynchronous bundle request with template ID, finite transform, optional validated instigator and an opaque request token.
requirements: Observe the correct scheduler boundary and establish exclusive access to the pending queue.
Keep generated content IDs, runtime entity handles, backend body IDs and Wasm tokens separate.
Recover completion after command flush, component initialization and resource readiness.
Track all children and retained resources under the requesting mod, including pending requests.
Resolve cancellation and despawn ordering, including owner unload and world replacement.
unresolved: queue synchronization and allowed calling phase
post-flush teardown and intentional persistent entities
